about: Evidence behind answer_levels_targets.json, copied from the measuring session of 2026-10-11 (scratchpad contest/). 'scores': every row of results/sameimage, scale, yoloe26, lookalike_towers, contrast and postfilter .jsonl (postfilter: the same pictures, marks and sizes as sameimage and scale, the finds raw and after the suggestion filter), and the YOLOE rows for tree crowns from results/scores.jsonl, verbatim, plus 'source'; a field a row did not record is filled and named in 'filled'. 'marks': for each measured set, the 3 boxes the user marked on each picture (width, height in the picture's own pixels), the picture's long side, and the size the finder read it at; the same pictures and marks as run_sameimage.py. The scripts and the pictures are not in this repository.
